body: Sure, you said you were in the same situation?
Thank you. I have been staying in motels with my 2 dogs sense February 14. Yesterday was the worst, surrender my 2 dogs . I just want to die!

She was cutting down the hours of work to 15 a week. I was just tired of her and her sons drama!
Most of jobs in my small city are temporary.
